empty-source-body.explanation: The legacy generator exposes a named page whose source body is intentionally empty.

empty-source-code.explanation: The legacy source contains an empty code block; the migration preserves its anchor and omits the empty fence without inventing a signature.

generated-fragment-alias.explanation: A stable alias was added so a legacy generated-page fragment remains reachable.

generated-fragment-normalized.explanation: A generated-page fragment was rewritten to the unique stable anchor exposed by its local target.

manual-fragment-alias.explanation: Stable aliases were added for legacy fragments that identify migrated headings.

manual-fragment-normalized.explanation: A legacy fragment was rewritten to the unique stable anchor exposed by its local target.

manual-mdx-normalized.explanation: Legacy MDX syntax was normalized to the repository Markdown/MDX authoring standard.

manual-platform-merge.explanation: Multiple platform-specific legacy MDX sources were merged with PlatformStructured blocks.

missing-source-text.explanation: The authoritative source omits user-visible text needed by the target format; the migration leaves it empty and requires supplied copy instead of synthesizing text.

source-only-link-removed.explanation: A link present only in generated source had no local visible target and was rendered as text instead of linking back to the old site.

unresolved-fragment.explanation: A legacy fragment could not be mapped to a stable target fragment.

unresolved-link.explanation: A legacy internal link has no resolved local target route.
